name: Rotating Platform
description: A 2x2 gear carries boxes around the maze — every pick spins it 90° anti-clockwise, so the box you need has to rotate into reach on the move you're ready to take it.
howToPlay: Every box you tap spins ALL platforms one quarter-turn anti-clockwise. The gear is walled in on three sides, so only the bottom-right seat can be picked. Tap it to grab that box and spin the next one into reach — a hidden box reveals the moment it rotates into the open. Use the free boxes at the bottom to spin the gear without spending a seat.
author: Claude prototype
